title: CheapSecurity – Lightweight, Self-Hosted CCTV for Linux SBCs
claim: Show HN: CheapSecurity – Lightweight, Self-Hosted CCTV for Linux SBCs
why_good: Lightweight self-hosted CCTV for cheap Linux single-board computers — a real value play for privacy-minded, budget home-security DIYers.
value: Open-core: free self-host, paid cloud/backup/alerts/mobile; a proven model (Frigate, Home Assistant).
risk: Frigate and the self-host camera ecosystem are strong; hardware fragmentation and reliability are the grind.
